question:
**Which of the following about the Hero Hockey India League 2024-25 (Women's) is/are correct?**

1.) Held in Ranchi & Rourkela (12-26 Jan).

2.) Odisha Warriors beat JSW Soorma in the final.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3 (Both 1 and 2 are correct)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• **Statement 1:** The Hero Hockey India League 2024-25 (Women's) was held in **Ranchi and Rourkela** from **12th to 26th January**. This fact is accurate and reflects the official schedule of the tournament. *Hence, statement 1 is correct.*

• **Statement 2:** The Odisha Warriors defeated the JSW Soorma team in the final match of the tournament, making them the champions for the 2024-25 season. This outcome is officially recorded. *Hence, statement 2 is correct.*

• The **Hero Hockey India League (Women's)** is an important platform for promoting women's hockey in India and provides opportunities for players to showcase their talent on a national level.

• The tournament is known for being hosted in locations with significant hockey infrastructure, such as **Rourkela**, home to the Birsa Munda International Hockey Stadium, one of the largest hockey stadiums in the world.

• **Both statements** 1 and 2 are correct based on the official records of the league. *Thus, Option 3 is the correct answer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **Hero Hockey India League (HIL):**

• The Hero Hockey India League was established in **2013** and is recognized by the **International Hockey Federation (FIH)**.

• The league aims to promote hockey in India by providing a professional platform for both men's and women's teams.

• It features top domestic and international players, enhancing the competitiveness and visibility of the sport.

• **Birsa Munda International Hockey Stadium:**

• Located in **Rourkela, Odisha**, this stadium is among the largest hockey venues globally.

• It has a seating capacity of approximately **20,000** and was inaugurated in **2023**.

• The stadium played a pivotal role in hosting matches for the **2023 Men's FIH Hockey World Cup**.

• **Odisha's Role in Indian Hockey:**

• Odisha is often referred to as the **"Cradle of Indian Hockey"** due to its rich hockey culture and infrastructure.

• The state government has been a consistent supporter of hockey, sponsoring both men's and women's national teams since **2018**.

• **Impact of Women's Hockey League:**

• The Hero Hockey India League (Women's) has encouraged greater participation in hockey among women and inspired young athletes.

• It serves as a feeder system for the **Indian national women's hockey team**, which has achieved significant success on the international stage in recent years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **Odisha Warriors:**

• The Odisha Warriors' victory in the 2024-25 season highlights the growing dominance of teams from Odisha in Indian hockey.

• The team showcased outstanding performances throughout the tournament, with notable contributions from both domestic and international players.

• **JSW Soorma:**

• JSW Soorma is another prominent team in the league, known for its consistent performances in previous seasons.

• Despite finishing as runners-up, the team demonstrated exceptional skill and sportsmanship in the final match.

• **Women's Hockey in India:**

• The Indian women's hockey team has made significant progress in recent years, highlighted by their performance at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics**, where they reached the semifinals.

• Initiatives like the Hero Hockey India League (Women's) contribute to the development of grassroots talent and the overall growth of the sport.
